sources.excerpt: Published on April 27, 2026 Cryptid Effects fuzz octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal Information The Cryptid Effects Siam Howler is a hybrid fuzz pedal that combines multiple vintage circuit influences into a single unit. Its core fuzz circuit is derived from the MSA Pedal Steel Fuzz, itself based on the Jordan Bosstone topology, and is modified through the use of germanium transistors and selectable clipping stages. An additional octave-up section, adapted from the Shin-Ei Super Fuzz, is integrated and can be engaged independently. The design incorporates a voltage-starve control applied to the main fuzz circuit, allowing adjustment of the supply voltage to alter response and gating characteristics. The pedal uses a combination of NOS Russian germanium components, including D9K diodes and GT310B and MP38B transistors, along with selectable clipping options that include no diodes, silicon diodes, germanium diodes, and yellow LEDs. This configuration provides a range of distortion textures from lower-gain vintage-style fuzz to more aggressive, clipped tones. The octave-up circuit includes a dedicated tuning control for adjusting its response when active. The Siam Howler is designed to operate flexibly within a signal chain and can be placed before or after other effects. It responds to input signal strength and may require boosting depending on pickup output, with higher input levels producing more pronounced saturation and harmonic content. It is intended for use both as a standalone fuzz and in combination with other gain stages to shape layered distortion sounds. Controls Howl : Output level control Hunger : Voltage-starve control applied to the main fuzz circuit Attack : Input trim control Snarl : Tone control Fangs : Clipping diode selector with options for none, yellow LED, germanium (D9K), and silicon Growl : Octave-up tuning control when the octave circuit is active Encounter : Footswitch for engaging the main effect Shriek : Footswitch for activating the octave-up circuit Connections Input : 6.35 mm (1/4 inch) instrument input Output : 6.35 mm (1/4 inch) instrument output Power : 9 V DC input, negative-tip (Boss-style) power supply Technical Specifications Current draw : 10 mA Power supply : 9 V DC, negative-tip Battery operation : Not supported Highlights Hybrid fuzz circuit based on MSA Pedal Steel Fuzz and Jordan Bosstone Integrated octave-up circuit derived from Shin-Ei Super Fuzz Voltage-starve control for altering circuit behavior Multiple clipping diode options including germanium, silicon, LED, or none Uses NOS Russian germanium diodes and transistors Flexible signal chain placement and compatibility with boosted input signals Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2026-03-29 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler - Humbuckers and C standard tuning 1:50 2026-03-28 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler - SSS Stratocaster 1:32 2026-03-27 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler - ES-345 1:26 2026-03-27 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler - EBMM St. Vincent 1:39 2026-03-10 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler 2:36 2026-01-02 Cryptid Effects The Siam Howler teaser trailer.
